lines.text: By the rivers of Babylon the captives sat and wept, and they hung their harps on the willows.
Their captors demanded songs of joy, and the psalmist asks how to sing the LORD's song in a foreign land.
The writer vows that his left hand would cease to function if he forgot Jerusalem.
The writer asks the LORD to remember the sons of Moab, who said on the day Jerusalem fell, "Tear it down."
The writer calls blessed the one who repays Babylon as it has done to them, and who dashes its infants against rocks.
